nodes.title: Young-band teach-back staging (PRODUCT-DESIGN-V2 §8): in the teachback phase, for the young family only (classes 1-3 since the dc-r7 band split), <Teacher protege> shows one of three fictional creatures (stable per child) at her lower right, sized by the window height so it stands beside her, never over her face. Its mood follows the child's last teach-back verdict (correct → happy, not_yet/partial → puzzled, never sad); while she listens or speaks she glances at it every 3.6 s (faceCues gaze 'protege'). Sprites re-encoded from public/assets/gen/protege (dropped from builds) to public/assets/teacher/protege/1/ (9 WebP, 108 KB, a shared crop per creature, provenance kept). Older bands keep Brain's 'Bittu' framing with no sprite. App applies docs/patches/to-app/005 (TeacherWindow).
